body:
I was legally prescribed tramadol 50 mg 3x/day for a painful soft-tissue injury to my hip. I'd only taken it a few times prior to today.  I did notice a slight improvement in my mood at the 50-mg dose.
Today it was hurting especially badly but I wanted to do my usual yoga session.  So I took 100 mg. After about an hour I felt (and still feel) really good.  Relaxed, floating, and certainly painless.  I've put on some trance music (Oceanlab) and am doing my yoga and am just basking in the long-lived sensation.  There is a very slight edginess and dizziness, but they aren't intrusive.
Wish this was how we felt all the time; there'd be no war.
